summary: Cadeler A/S filed a 6-K reporting a major-shareholder notification tied to the completed share exchange offer for its redomiciliation from Denmark to the UK. Scorpio Holdings tendered 49,356,825 Cadeler shares (~12.78% of capital and votes, DKK 1.00 nominal) for an equal number of Cadeler plc shares (USD 1.00 nominal), leaving Scorpio with zero direct Cadeler A/S shares but 13.89% of Cadeler plc, since 7.94% of holders did not tender. Settlement commencement follows the 2 November 2026 final-results announcement; no board recommendation, advisor, price, or premium disclosed. Watch post-Offer free float and residual non-tendered stub.
